description: Relaunch an already-launched Toolfound listing: same listing, same URL, a new launch date shown alongside the old one. Relaunch requires a fresh verified-owner session, so this anonymous MCP transport reports the eligibility result but directs owners to the dashboard to authorize the write.

email.description: Claimed-owner email. The relaunch must still be authorized from its verified dashboard session.

note.description: Required: one line about what changed since the original launch (10-200 characters). Shown publicly on the listing page.

requested_launch_date.description: Preferred new launch date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the next 180 days. Use toolfound_get_launch_calendar to find open featured seats. Falls back to the earliest open day if omitted or full.

slug.description: Slug of the listing to relaunch.

name: toolfound_relaunch
title: Relaunch a listing
